verdict: NOT APPROVED at the encoding/order gate. Verified on the actual v3 XML: canonical identities, scoped Bible quote-contexts with terminators, Hebrew–English alignment, both piyyutim complete (44 weekday / 46 Shabbat), and the five sic/corr corrections. Also verified: German and Hebrew language tagging, אומר with no quiet direction, no bogus Hayom variants, Areshet zikhron owned by the source host, pure word libraries, and no @rend. Recitation order is correct in all three spines. Every V1 finding closes on the unit XML: the false pbs on the weekday verses, Shabbat lead-in and Jer 31:19; the ed-qualified Efchad breaks; the zikhron duplicate; the Hayom choice; the 26/27 quotation mark; the split seg@source; break=no; the 843 count; and the supplied arrangements. Blocking: (1) the HE index and HE QA spine add two spurious pb ed=1965 n=136, so page 136 is crossed up to three times, which repeats the V1 false-page-start class; (2) both real indexes keep a stale draft-gap note saying Zikhronot is not yet included; (3) the EN stream has no primary ed=1965 page-128 break. The semantic-assertion report also says 'passed' while showing brit_selection_correct=false in 6 cases. Realization-binding renewal is withheld: the 141 prior hashes cannot be verified by reading, and the shared source-order contexts they depend on contain the blocking defects. This is not an export acceptance.
